import re

def parse(lines):
    head = {}
    headl = []
    members = []
    meml = []
    ins = []
    insl = []
    exc = []
    excl = []
    lnt = []
    lntl = []
    skip = []
    cur = ''
    sec = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        s = l.strip()
        m = re.match(r'^Compiled from "(.*)"\s*$', l)
        if m:
            head['Compiled from'] = m.group(1)
            headl.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\S.*\{\s*$', l):
            head['class'] = s[:-1].strip()
            headl.append(i)
            continue
        if s == '}':
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^  (\S.*?);\s*$', l)
        if m:
            cur = m.group(1)
            members.append({'member': cur, 'descriptor': ''})
            meml.append(i)
            sec = None
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+descriptor: (.*)$', l)
        if m and members:
            members[-1]['descriptor'] = m.group(1).strip()
            meml.append(i)
            continue
        if s == 'Code:':
            sec = 'code'
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if s == 'Exception table:':
            sec = 'exc'
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if s == 'LineNumberTable:':
            sec = 'lnt'
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if sec == 'exc':
            if re.match(r'^from\s+to\s+target\s+type$', s):
                skip.append(i)
                continue
            m = re.match(r'^\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\S.*?)\s*$', l)
            if m:
                exc.append({'member': cur, 'from': int(m.group(1)), 'to': int(m.group(2)), 'target': int(m.group(3)), 'type': m.group(4)})
                excl.append(i)
                continue
        if sec == 'lnt':
            m = re.match(r'^\s+line (\d+): (\d+)\s*$', l)
            if m:
                lnt.append({'member': cur, 'line': int(m.group(1)), 'offset': int(m.group(2))})
                lntl.append(i)
                continue
        if sec == 'code':
            m = re.match(r'^\s+(\d+): ([a-z]\w*)(.*)$', l)
            if m:
                rest = m.group(3)
                cm = ''
                if '//' in rest:
                    rest, cm = rest.split('//', 1)
                ins.append({'member': cur, 'offset': int(m.group(1)), 'opcode': m.group(2), 'operands': rest.strip(), 'comment': cm.strip()})
                insl.append(i)
                continue
    blocks = []
    if head:
        blocks.append({'name': 'class', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': headl, 'records': [head]})
    if members:
        blocks.append({'name': 'members', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': meml, 'records': members})
    if ins:
        blocks.append({'name': 'instructions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': insl, 'records': ins})
    if exc:
        blocks.append({'name': 'exception_table', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': excl, 'records': exc})
    if lnt:
        blocks.append({'name': 'line_numbers', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': lntl, 'records': lnt})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
